bio: Zuan Ca' Zefri is a methodical and calculating individual whose rise from ship chandler's son to respected Cittadini has sharpened both his business acumen and his protective instincts toward his carefully built reputation. His meticulous nature and ability to maintain detailed records while navigating complex social relationships reflect a mind that values precision and discretion above all else.
